external_ai_claim_triage.reason: No latent/truth information crosses the inspected PRE firewall. The correct classification is oracle-like simulator affinity / construct alignment, which blocks reality interpretation but is not data leakage.
2026 official program material lists GIII 7-rider and 9-rider program variants.

external_ai_claim_triage.claim: competition score should not be modeled as latent skill plus iid Gaussian noise
external_ai_claim_triage.reason: Official race-card material defines competition score as a recent historical-performance statistic. Current Gaussian construction is an engineering proxy, not a calibrated real-score model.

external_ai_claim_triage.claim: symmetric same-line mean benefit is a realistic line model
external_ai_claim_triage.reason: Official line material describes directional role-dependent cooperation, blocking, switching and position competition, not a symmetric equal uplift from arithmetic mean ability.

external_ai_claim_triage.claim: PL should be removed as baseline
external_ai_claim_triage.reason: Repository design explicitly uses C0 PL as a structural null/control and feature-vs-architecture ablation baseline, not as a claim that PL is the real race generator.

top_5_foundation_fixes.action: Preserve W0-W4 unchanged as ENGINEERING_ADVERSARIAL_SYNTHETIC_WORLDS and create a separately versioned REALITY_CALIBRATED_WORLD_FAMILY. Prohibit cross-labeling engineering wins as reality evidence.

Reality-calibrated worlds must represent actual grade/program/regime/field-size distinctions and source their prevalence/eligibility from official material rather than hard-coded S/A12/A3 scenario priors.

Separate latent rider state from official historical PRE statistics. Add persistent rider identity and point-in-time historical processes before calling any Synthetic score a model of competition score.

Model line formation from rider/context relationships rather than random membership, and independently prove timestamped PRE_EVENT_EXPECTED_LINE / LEGSHOW_OBSERVED_LINE transport before any real line-dependent validation.

Every reality-oriented candidate must be tested across truth mechanisms and parameter ranges not copied from the candidate. Label generator-informed controls explicitly; do not use a matched coefficient or predicate family as reality evidence.
